verdict.rationale: The API and Zapier integration (docs-1) suggest mail/scan data could be exported programmatically, and automation rules (docs-2/17) imply workflow access to mail data, but there is no explicit documentation of bulk export of PDFs/scans or metadata, no bulk-download feature described, and probes show no discoverable API spec to confirm scope. missing for 10: explicit bulk export/download feature for scans and metadata, documentation of API endpoints covering scan history, independent confirmation of bulk export working.
